The removed line is hand made on ZookeeperValidatePathsTest.java as of the last commit that changed it, da22909747a9205b7097b2ab0b2b802a7b986a4f on the default branch; every context line is that file's own, and the now unused imports are left in place. No method target: the runner covers every nested test class. Not from IDoFT: neither the repository nor the test class appears in pr-data.csv under any status.
